identity.title: Rotational spectroscopy, tentative interstellar detection, and chemical modeling of N-methylformamide

paper_type_evidence.quote: We search for N-methylformamide toward the hot molecular core Sagittarius (Sgr) B2(N2) using a spectral line survey carried out with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA).

question.value: Can improved laboratory rotational spectroscopy of trans N-methylformamide enable its detection toward Sgr B2(N2) in the ALMA EMoCA survey, and how can its abundance relative to related molecules be explained by chemical modelling?

evidence.quote: our goal is to improve the characterization of the rotational spectrum of N-methylformamide.
The astronomical results are put into a broader astrochemical context with the help of a gas-grain chemical kinetics model.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00017.S, ADS/JAO.ALMA#2012.1.00012.S.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00017.S, ADS/JAO.ALMA#2012.1.00012.S.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 84.1-114.4 GHz, spectral resolution 488.3 kHz (1.7 to 1.3 km/s)

evidence.quote: The survey covers the frequency range between 84.1 and 114.4 GHz with a spectral resolution of 488.3 kHz (1.7 to 1.3 km s$^{-1}$).
The median angular resolution is 1.6$\ensuremath{''}$.
We use the full data set of the EMoCA spectral line survey obtained toward Sgr B2(N) with ALMA in its Cycles 0 and 1.

method.value: Rho-axis method Hamiltonian fitted with RAM36 to new plus literature data

evidence.quote: To fit and predict the rotational spectra we used the RAM36 (Rho-axis method for 3 and 6-fold barriers) program
The fit chosen as the "best" one uses a model consisting of 103 parameters.
The weighted root-mean-square deviation of the fit of 12456 microwave transition frequencies with $J \leq 62$ is 0.84

method.value: Direct summation over rotational-torsional states plus harmonic vibrational part from DFT B3LYP

evidence.quote: The values of $Q_{\rm tr}$ were calculated from first principles, i.e. via direct summation over the rotational-torsional states.

key_parameters.value: J up to 130, vt up to 8; B3LYP/6-311++(3df,2pd)

evidence.quote: The maximum value of the $J$ quantum number of the energy levels taken into account to calculate the partition function is 130, and excited torsional states up to $\varv_{\rm t} = 8$ were considered.

findings_qualitative.value: Five unblended lines assigned to CH3NHCHO (four in vt=0, one in vt=1); detection tentative

evidence.quote: In total, five lines can be clearly assigned to CH$_3$NHCHO, four within its torsional ground state and one within its first torsionally excited state.

findings_qualitative.value: Efficient HNCO formation via NH + CO on grains is needed to reproduce CH3NCO

evidence.quote: The chemical models indicate that the efficient formation of HNCO via NH + CO on grains is a necessary step in the achievement of the observed gas-phase abundance of CH$_3$NCO.

claims.hypothesis: Improved spectroscopy allows reliable detection of N-methylformamide in Sgr B2(N2)
claims.experiment: LTE modelling of ALMA EMoCA spectrum with new predictions
claims.result: Five unblended lines match; N ~1e17 cm-2

evidence.quote: Given the small number of clearly detected lines, we consider our detection of CH$_3$NHCHO as tentative rather than secure.

claims.hypothesis: Formation of CH3NHCHO and CH3NCO can be explained by grain chemistry
claims.result: Models with NH+CO barrier <~1500 K and H+CH3NCO barrier ~2000 K reproduce ratios
claims.finding: Radical addition or hydrogenation of CH3NCO plausible

evidence.quote: Under such conditions, a barrier to the hydrogenation of CH$_3$NCO may be estimated to be around 2000 K to best reproduce observed abundances of N-methylformamide.

claims.hypothesis: Isomer ratio follows minimum energy principle
claims.finding: Kinetics rather than thermodynamics likely controls abundances

evidence.quote: Therefore, the abundance ratio of the two isomers has most likely an origin based on kinetics over a simple thermal equilibrium.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Removing NH2 + H2CO route reduces NH2CHO by an order of magnitude but acetamide still overproduced

evidence.quote: However, even the better match to observed NH$_2$CHO is not sufficient to bring down acetamide abundances to appropriate levels

limitations_admitted.value: Only five clean lines, so detection tentative

evidence.quote: Given the small number of clearly detected lines, we consider our detection of CH$_3$NHCHO as tentative rather than secure.

limitations_admitted.value: Models overproduce NH2CHO and CH3CONH2 by more than an order of magnitude

evidence.quote: all four models produce an overabundance of NH$_2$CHO and CH$_3$CONH$_2$ by more than an order of magnitude
